summary: Rows with length at most kCap are converted to ELL and processed by the GPU; rows longer than kCap retain full CSR data and are traversed by an OpenMP host worker. The timed loop invokes both paths once per runtime iteration, after which GPU results are copied and long-row outputs overwrite their corresponding row slots before gather. The GPU ELL SASS intentionally only covers eligible rows; CPU compiled worker covers full [rowStart,rowEnd) for each long row. Evidence supplement: the timed active path calls the ELL kernel stub at 4f90; its full helper calls cudaLaunchKernel. The GPU SASS ranges now extend through the final ELL store; the CPU long-row worker was independently checked in the cited host ranges.
